name: adr-ai-manager
description: Select commits, let Claude decide whether they warrant an Architecture Decision Record, answer a few targeted questions, and generate a structured ADR — without fabricated rationale.

commands.title: ADR AI: Generate ADR from Commits…
ADR AI: Set Anthropic API Key
ADR AI: Clear Stored Anthropic API Key

adrAi.directory.markdownDescription: Directory (relative to the repository root) where ADR files live. Created on first use if missing.

adrAi.model.markdownDescription: Anthropic model id used for assessment and ADR generation.

adrAi.maxQuestions.markdownDescription: Maximum number of targeted questions the AI may ask the developer before generating the ADR. Keep it low — friction is what kills these tools.

adrAi.baseBranch.markdownDescription: Base branch to diff the current branch against when listing commits (e.g. `main`). Leave empty to auto-detect (`origin/HEAD`, then `main`/`master`/`develop`).

adrAi.commitLimit.markdownDescription: How many recent commits to list when the current branch has no commits ahead of the base branch.

adrAi.maxDiffChars.markdownDescription: Maximum number of diff characters sent to the model. Larger diffs are truncated to stay within token limits.

adrAi.anthropicApiKey.markdownDescription: Anthropic API key. **For security, prefer the `ADR AI: Set Anthropic API Key` command (stored in VS Code Secret Storage) or the `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` environment variable instead of this setting.**
